text: Mr. Rich aspired to get a self- portrait made by an artist. He went to the workshop of Mr. Kalakar an artist and 4   asked whether he could sketch the former’s portrait on oil painting canvass. Mr. Kalakar agreed to the offer and asked for ₹ 50,000 as full advance payment for the above creative work. Mr. Kalakar clarified that the painting shall be completed in 10 sittings and-shall take 3 months. After the 5th sitting, Mr. Rich was informed that Mr. Kalakar has suffered paralysis and it would be impossible to paint for the near future. Mr. Kalakar had a son, Mr.Sonu, who was still pursuing his studies and had not taken up his father’s profession yet. Discuss in the light of Indian Contract Act, 1872, whether Mr. Rich can ask Mr.Sonu to complete the artistic work in place of his father? Could Mr. Rich ask Mr. Sonu for refund of money paid in advance to his father?
